summary: Microtraction provides pre-seed funding for African technology entrepreneurs. Its homepage says it invests $100,000 in teams with a technical founder at the earliest stage, and lists fit criteria such as identified customers, a built MVP and a two-to-three person team. The FAQ states standard terms of $100,000 for 7%, up to $350,000 more in later rounds, a sector-agnostic view, and a focus on African founders building global businesses. Founders apply through a form. A street address is not stated.

investmentEvidence.fact: The FAQ and homepage describe Microtraction as a first check into African founders; individual companies such as LemFi and Risevest are linked from the homepage without round or date.

sources.title: Homepage: $100k pre-seed checks for African technical founders and application link
FAQ: standard terms, follow-on, sector-agnostic view and geography
